annotations.title: The most searched new products today (the home page's first row)

description: The products the home page's first row shows, found by the data and not by a list of model names: new products people look for, up to 12, each a summary like search_products (total price with shipping at a rated shop, shops, in stock, capture time) plus `trending` with `score`, `parts` (the points of generation, newness, interest, gsc, growth, keyword, seed) and `raw` (model number and its place among the line's generations, days since the family entered the catalogue, decayed interest, Search Console weight, shops that started to list it, variants). A product qualifies when its model number is the newest or the one before in its line (iPhone 18 against iPhone 17), or its model family entered the catalogue in the last 75 days, and someone searched for it, clicked to a shop, found it on Google or a shop started to list it; the score adds model generation 40, newness 10, searches (halved every 7 days over 28 days) and human clicks 25 × log2(1 + n), Search Console 15 × log2(1 + n), new shops 12 × log2(1 + n). Colours and capacities are one card (the cheapest variant); at most 4 cards per category, 3 per brand and 3 per shop. Only products with two or more shops, a rated shop with known shipping and a price in stock; a shop on the ČOI/SOI risk list is never shown. Recomputed by the worker each night; `generated_at` says when, null before the first run. Next: get_product with a product slug for the full comparison.
